svg.title: Cumulative temporal path variation
svg.desc: What this figure shows: Cumulative path variation is nondecreasing because it sums nonnegative adjacent structural distances. The plotted object is generated from V_0:T = sum_t Dbar([c_t],[c_t+1]). How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Synthetic visualization of Proposition 14. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
